questions.text: The NATIVE AMERICAN groups that lived in Texas before European explorers arrived included the Comanche, Cherokee, and Caddo. The Caddo were known for ___
options: farming, building permanent villages, and trading
living primarily along the coast and fishing
questions.answer: farming, building permanent villages, and trading

questions.text: The COMANCHE were one of the most powerful Native American groups in Texas. They were known for ___
options: building cities along the Rio Grande
being skilled horsemen who followed buffalo herds across the plains
farming corn and building permanent villages
questions.answer: being skilled horsemen who followed buffalo herds across the plains

questions.text: The Spanish built MISSIONS in Texas primarily to ___
options: establish military bases to protect against France
convert Native Americans to Christianity and expand Spanish control
create trading posts for European merchants
questions.answer: convert Native Americans to Christianity and expand Spanish control

questions.text: The EMPRESARIO SYSTEM, used by Mexico to encourage settlement of Texas, gave land grants to ___
options: agents (empresarios) who brought settlers to Texas
questions.answer: agents (empresarios) who brought settlers to Texas

questions.text: The TEXAS DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE was signed on March 2, 1836. It declared Texas independent from ___
questions.answer: Mexico

questions.text: During the REPUBLIC OF TEXAS period (1836-1845), Texas was ___
options: a state of the United States
questions.answer: an independent nation

questions.text: After the Civil War, the period of rebuilding the South was called ___
questions.answer: Reconstruction

questions.text: The discovery of OIL at Spindletop near Beaumont in 1901 transformed Texas because it ___
options: began the Texas oil industry and led to tremendous economic growth
caused many people to leave Texas
questions.answer: began the Texas oil industry and led to tremendous economic growth

questions.text: The PHYSICAL REGIONS of Texas include the Coastal Plains, North Central Plains, Great Plains, and Mountains and Basins. Which region receives the MOST rainfall?
questions.answer: Coastal Plains (East Texas/Gulf Coast)

questions.text: The RIO GRANDE forms the border between Texas and ___
questions.answer: Mexico

questions.text: ABSOLUTE LOCATION is described using ___
options: landmarks like 'near the river' or 'south of the mountains'
questions.answer: latitude and longitude coordinates

questions.text: RELATIVE LOCATION describes where a place is ___
options: in relation to other places ('south of Dallas' or 'near the coast')
questions.answer: in relation to other places ('south of Dallas' or 'near the coast')

questions.text: The BILL OF RIGHTS is the first ten amendments to the U.S. Constitution. It primarily protects ___
options: the power of the government over citizens
the individual rights and freedoms of citizens
the military forces of the United States
the rights of businesses and corporations
questions.answer: the individual rights and freedoms of citizens

questions.text: CHECKS AND BALANCES in the U.S. government means that ___
options: the president has all the power
each branch of government has power over the others to prevent any one branch from becoming too powerful
the Supreme Court controls the other branches
questions.answer: each branch of government has power over the others to prevent any one branch from becoming too powerful

questions.text: TARIFFS are taxes placed on ___
questions.answer: goods imported from other countries

questions.text: OPPORTUNITY COST is ___
options: the total price of a product
the value of the NEXT BEST alternative you give up when making a choice
the profit made from selling a product
questions.answer: the value of the NEXT BEST alternative you give up when making a choice

questions.text: SPECIALIZATION in economics means that ___
options: everyone produces all the things they need
regions or people focus on producing what they do best and trade for other things
countries refuse to trade with each other
farmers grow only one type of crop every year
questions.answer: regions or people focus on producing what they do best and trade for other things

questions.text: Texas AGRICULTURE (farming and ranching) is an important part of the state's economy. Texas leads the nation in production of ___
questions.answer: cattle, cotton, and sheep

questions.text: A HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT INTERACTION occurs when humans ___
options: observe animals in nature without touching them
change or adapt to the natural environment
questions.answer: change or adapt to the natural environment

questions.text: Irrigation is an example of humans MODIFYING (changing) their environment because ___
options: it channels water to fields that would otherwise be too dry to farm
it prevents flooding by removing water from areas
questions.answer: it channels water to fields that would otherwise be too dry to farm
